text:
maya: Heads-up — nightly eval triggered a regression on the conversational promptset, 48 failures out of 520 (was 7 last night). failing cluster looks like confident but incorrect factual answers. anyone else seeing this?

liam: saw the alert. preliminary diff shows much higher F1 drop on knowledge prompts. linked eval run: https://evals.internal/runs/1839991109

sara: summary from the job: model-redwood-onnx-int8-v3 was the new candidate in the canary. baseline is model-redwood-fp16-v7.

eval-bot: nightly-eval: run 1839991109 finished. metrics: accuracy:-9.2%, hallucination_rate:+14.7%, avg_latency:-6% (faster). Full CSV attached to run.

jordan: key observation — failures correlate with long-context QA prompts (context > 1024 tokens) and with a particular tokenization pattern (multibyte sequences near context boundary).

maya: hypothesis: int8 quant + new ONNX KV-eviction parameter changes cause prefix decay for long contexts. int8 made it cheaper (latency drop), but we're trading off stability.

liam: I reproduced locally with a subset of failing prompts. command I ran:
```
./tools/run_eval --model=model-redwood-onnx-int8-v3 --prompts=tests/failing_long_context.csv --seed=42 --logits_dump=logits.json
```
Logs show sudden drop in top token probabilities after ~1100 tokens and repeated short loops in answers.

sara: dug into logits.json for one failing case — probability mass shifts to incorrect tokens while attention scores to early prefixes decay. patch of attention weights shows a stride mismatch (kv_index off by 1) when using the new tokenizer's byte-pair offsets.

jordan: TL;DR root cause draft: combination of (1) ONNX int8 kernel changes that alter numeric rounding for KV cache writes, (2) a tokenization update that changed some multi-codepoint boundary alignments, and (3) a new KV eviction heuristic intended to reduce memory for long contexts. Together they cause stale/shifted KV entries for certain contexts, producing overconfident but wrong completions.

maya: Proposed mitigations:
- immediate: rollback canary — stop model-redwood-onnx-int8-v3 deployments and re-pin routes to model-redwood-fp16-v7 (ops action).
- short term: add a nightly-gate that blocks any quantized model variant until pass rate >= 99% on the long-context promptset for 3 consecutive runs.
- medium term: add unit-level prompt tests that assert logits/top-k stability (delta thresholds) for critical prompts; run as part of model vetting pipeline.
- long term: add a KV-cache consistency test (instrument cache writes/reads and compare indices across precision modes).

liam: created a rollback runbook snippet:
```
# rollback canary route
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/route/update" -d '{"route":"/chat","model":"model-redwood-fp16-v7","force":true}'
# notify infra and run canary rollback job
```
I'll kick it off if ops give the go.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started rollback to model-redwood-fp16-v7 on canary cluster (canary-id: c-72). ETA 4m.

maya: thanks — once rollback completes let's run a differential eval between fp16-v7 and the int8 candidate on the failing prompt subset and upload logits+attention traces to S3 for deeper inspection.

sara: I've flagged the tokenizer PR (rev: token-2026-04-11) as a suspect and opened a revert PR to restore previous offsets while we investigate.

jordan: follow-up actions (owner tags):
- liam: finish logits+attn diffs + attach to ticket ML-2341.
- sara: revert tokenizer change and run the full nightly.
- maya: add the nightly-gate rule + update model onboarding checklist to require cross-precision KV-cache tests.
- infra (ops): hold any further int8 canaries until gate is in place.

maya: provisional classification: quality regression due to interaction between quantization and tokenization + KV cache heuristic. severity: P2 (user impact on long-context QA).

liam: I'll post an interim write-up in the ticket and attach the failing prompt set and a minimal repro.

maya: thanks everyone. add any other observations here. :thumbsup:

jordan: one last note — let's add a small canary test that runs 100 long-context prompts at deploy time with strict top-1 accuracy thresholds. If it fails, auto-block the deployment.

sara: +1 on auto-block canary. Also creating an eval alert to surface similar tokenization drift in future.

maya: closing the loop for now — ops reported rollback complete and nightly re-run started (watching).
